newsitem.title: UK: UK's T&N rejects GKN approach for unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's T&N rejects GKN approach for unit - paper.

text.p: UK engine parts group T&N Plc rebuffed an approach by auto components maker GKN Plc for its high-technology materials unit, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
The powder-metallurgy division was valued at about 250 million stg, the paper said.
The report said GKN's approach, made shortly after T&N unveiled a plan to cap its exposure to asbestos-related insurance claims, could heighten speculation that GKN might launch a full bid for T&N.
A GKN spokesman said the company was interested in expanding its powder-metallurgy operations, but added that it had not had any formal talks with T&N about buying that company's division.

"No formal talks have ever taken place, at least not in recent months, anyway. Although obviously, we're all in the same automotive industry, so we do meet people from T&N quite a lot," the GKN spokesman said.
"Certainly there's no question of GKN making a bid for the whole of T&N, simply because of the asbestos situation," he added. "I think it's highly unlikely."
The Sunday Times said T&N was valued at about 907 million stg, although it added that some analysts estimated its worth at at least 1.3 billion stg after the recent insurance deal.
T&N was not immediately available for comment.
